prose.subject: Update to Payout Account and Invoice INV-71221
prose.body:
Hi Maya,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inform you of a recent administrative update regarding our payment processing channels at Yarrow Logistics.

Our finance team has established a new treasury account to streamline our disbursement workflows and improve reconciliation accuracy for our partners. Please note that our future payouts will be directed via the account yarrowlogistics59-treasury.testnet. We have linked this account to our verified domain, yarrow-logistics.example, to ensure secure authentication and trust continuity.

As part of this transition, I am attaching invoice INV-71221 for your records. The total amount due is 3386.78 USDC. Please verify that the account details match the string yarrowlogistics59-treasury.testnet before processing the transfer. If you have any questions regarding the new account structure or the invoice contents, please let me know and I will be happy to clarify.

Thank you for your continued partnership and prompt attention to this update.

Best regards,

Ines Tanaka
Operations Manager
Yarrow Logistics
